business_summary: Gates Industrial Corporation Ltd. manufactures and sells engineered power transmission and fluid power solutions in the United States, rest of North America, South America, the United Kingdom, Luxembourg, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, India, East Asia, and Greater China. It operates through two segments, Power Transmission and Fluid Power. The company offers solutions for stationary and mobile drives, engine systems, and personal mobility application platforms; elastomer drive belts; asynchronous and synchronous belts, including V-belts, transmission belts, and micro-V belts; metal drive components, such as tensioners, idlers, pulleys, sprockets, mechanical water pumps, and other accessories used in belt drive systems; and kits for the automotive replacement channel. It also provides fluid power solutions for stationary and mobile hydraulics, vehicle systems, and other industrial application platforms; hydraulics comprising hoses, tubing, couplings, and fittings, as well as assemblies; thermal and emissions management and related products; and industrial hoses, including data center pumps. The company's products are used in applications across various markets, including diversified industrial applications comprising automated manufacturing, logistics systems, and data centers; consumer applications consisting of printers, power washers, automatic doors, and vacuum cleaners; industrial off-highway, such as construction and agriculture; industrial on-highway commercial vehicles, including heavy-duty trucks and buses; energy and resources markets, such as oil, gas, and mining; and personal mobility, including scooters, motorcycles, bicycles, all-terrain vehicles, and snowmobiles. It sells its products under the Gates brand. The company offers its products to aftermarket channel customers and original equipment manufacturers. Gates Industrial Corporation Ltd. was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
business_summary_ko: Gates Industrial Corporation Ltd.는 미국, 북미 지역, 남미 지역, 영국, 룩셈부르크, 유럽 지역, 중동, 아프리카, 인도, 동아시아 및 중화권에서 엔지니어링 동력 전달 및 유체 동력 솔루션을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이는 동력 전달과 유체 동력이라는 두 부분을 통해 작동됩니다. 이 회사는 고정식 및 이동식 드라이브, 엔진 시스템, 개인 이동성 애플리케이션 플랫폼을 위한 솔루션을 제공합니다. 엘라스토머 구동 벨트; V-벨트, 전동 벨트 및 마이크로-V 벨트를 포함한 비동기식 및 동기식 벨트; 텐셔너, 아이들러, 풀리, 스프로킷, 기계식 워터 펌프 및 벨트 구동 시스템에 사용되는 기타 액세서리와 같은 금속 구동 부품; 자동차 교체 채널용 키트. 또한 고정식 및 이동식 유압 장치, 차량 시스템 및 기타 산업 응용 플랫폼을 위한 유체 동력 솔루션을 제공합니다. 호스, 튜빙, 커플링, 피팅 및 어셈블리로 구성된 유압장치; 열 및 배출 관리 및 관련 제품; 데이터 센터 펌프를 포함한 산업용 호스. 이 회사의 제품은 다음을 포함하여 다양한 시장의 응용 분야에 사용됩니다.
